scope: UI capture metadata and decoded image integrity only. This does not verify API side effects, persistence, business outcomes, or action causality.
recording_method: CUA screenshots sampled during real clicks and scroll; no invented UI state; timing gaps may be shortened in edit
excluded: Images absent from recording.json, including the earlier failed crop, were not audited.
coordinate_basis: Recorded action coordinates compared directly with stored frame pixel bounds; independent CSS/device-pixel ratio metadata is not present.
pixel_change_basis: Exact decoded RGB comparison. A change can include animation, scrolling, or JPEG differences and is not proof of a successful API mutation.

actions.target: 絵付けと仕上げをする・開催を選ぶ

change_from_previous_in_group.note: Dimensions differ; pixel-count comparisons are omitted, not rescaled or cropped.

limitations: A single pc-city frame has a different size. The capture files were not changed or excluded.
